annotations.title: Get betting picks for a match

description: tactica.'s official Betting Intelligence picks for one fixture, at most one per market (Result, Goals, Both Teams To Score), each with its family, market, selection label, tier (Conviction, Core or Edge) and tactica.'s chance for it. Picks only: no odds. Use this when you want what to back on one specific match. Use get_top_five instead for the strongest picks across all fixtures, or get_match_forecast for chances alone. A fixture with no pick returns a not-available error. Read-only; current picks at call time. 18+. Information, not betting or financial advice. Paid: 2.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113
